name: Azeroth Companion
title: WORLD DISCOVERY ASCENSION — Unified Search & Real Map Enhancement
approval_note: Owner authorized v23 roadmap. Implemented validated subset: unified discovery, sourced Midnight map expansion, search/encounter/legacy item integration, touch and fullscreen. Complete loot indexing, reliable gathering-density heatmaps and verified dungeon interiors are not represented as finished.
features: Unify location, boss, instance, selected loot/legacy collectibles, gathering landmarks and travel research in one map sidebar.
Add Midnight Silvermoon City and Eversong Woods sourced 2393/2395 map viewers with selected verified coordinates.
Introduce fullscreen map mode and pointer-driven two-finger zoom while retaining existing wheel-free touch and desktop buttons.
Preserve original map image fallback, coordinates macro, saved routes, mission and personal pins, plus external source references.
No fabricated indoor maps, heatmaps, loot rates or character ownership. No OAuth or backend changes.
